notes.title: Dawn of Ages, Update 2.3.3
notes.notes: [h3]The soldiers within the conflict have plundered a great deal from our enemies. of those a grand Scimitar, and flawless shield stand above all. The king has ordered them studied, so we may create our own, and we have succeeded. Please see the research notes below.[/h3][h1]Content[/h1][list][*][p]New Mythic-Perks[/p][list][*][p]Mythic Scimitar Perk: Reckless Swing[/p][list][*][p]A critical strike increases Area Chance by 100% for 1 attack. 5s Cooldown[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/8e6e83143276af1daf3f0418c8eefd04f8446882.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mythic Kite Shield Perk: Deflect[/p][list][*][p]A Successful Melee block returns 100% of the damage back to the attacker. (reduced by armor.)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]                                                  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/14a6dacc382ea5b6897e9e6b201b2ed2875776ac.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]We have added clan levels 14 and 15.[/p][list][*][p]We have added Clan Bosses 17 and 18.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Mythic Items count now as 2 rarities higher within the game data, than legendaries.[/p][list][*][p]This results in higher damage/armor values[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Weapon Research Changes[/p][list][*][p]Blunt Weapons: We have added a Damage Increase of 20 on top of the 20 Minimum damage increase.[/p][/*][*][p]Slash Weapons: We have reduced Crit Damage from 10/20/30/40/50 to 4/8/12/16/20% (The crit Chance increase remains the same)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Perks with a Stack Limit above 1 will now stack correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Anglo Saxon Skill Tree.[/p][list][*][p]The Robin’s Flight Skill now also buffs throw range.[/p][/*][*][p]The Momentum Skill now also buffs throw damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have added the missing Collect All Button to the inbox for PC versions.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1][list][*][p]The Power value of mythic items currently presents as lower than the actual value their damage and armor values supply.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dawn of Ages 2.3.1
notes.notes: [h1][i]Content[/i][/h1][p]The Tides of war rise once more, as Saladin renews his marches upon the west, the people tremble in fear. Some have even fled fearing a repeat of the Genghis invasion, or the El Cid invasion, or the other Saladin invasion. One thing is certain, our people are in great peril, and we are in need of warriors capable of putting an end to this vicious cycle.[/p][h2]Saladin event[/h2][list][*][p]The Saladin Event Returns, better than ever.[/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f7849001d310c5ce85e0c4db35cc3e95c1a781b4.png"][/img][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Holy Lance: We have increased the Holy Lance’s entourage from -3 to -2. (They have 1 more unit now.)[/p][/*][*][p]Damage falloff for the Handgonne has been reduced from 50% to 40%, this means the minimum splash damage is 60%, up from 50%. (This is a buff)[/p][/*][*][p]Saladin Sandstorm: Now applies +100% Evasion to Saladin during the Sandstorm[/p][/*][*][p]Saladin: We have increased Saladin’s base evasion by a factor of 1.81 (at max level, base evasion goes from 55 → 100)[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug [b]Fixing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing the negotiation Clan Research to not work.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed several performance issues with Battle Passes.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed skins in the skin merging selection - now only a single skin type can be select in a melting or merging function.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the research donation target initially set being cleared.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the resource display in the Refinery.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the skip level animation on the skip by gems function.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed Battle pass skip costs..[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the shop rewards layout.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Clan City update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/340a3aa30027ddfcdf960c2b1c4f27a8125ffd16.png"][/img][/p][h1]Patchnotes 2.2.0[/h1][h3]The Clans have united in a Grand City, a truce has been called so leaders may unite and convene. This grand occasion marks the first step towards unity under the Kings Banner, though not all is well. Conflict already stirs as the far reaching Clans vie for influence and power within the castle. Though peace is assured for now, under threat of the realms wrath, the people are already aware the war is looming. For when the opportunity for power and gain arise, it is often in the best interest of the strong to remove their opposition. The individual Cities are already preparing for war, now all must choose a side, or be destroyed as a consequence.[/h3][h1][b][u]Content[/u][/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b][i]Clan City[/i][/b][/h2][p]The Clan City is a centralized hub for all clan activities. It replaces the previous Clan Hall UI. Similar to a player's city, the Clan City consists of multiple specialized buildings that each represent different systems and unlock exclusive clan features.[/p][list][*][p]Key buildings include:[/p][list][*][p]Clan Headquarters: This is the central building, which controls other building levels within the Clan City.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/1c7696428afd58ea0a6374470d96c6f96d3f7c45.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]University: This building unlocks new research and technologies, it also increases the maximum member count for your clan, and provides buffs.[/p][/*][/list][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f747400936236bdb317f20c43709713efcf6556d.png"][/img][/h2][list][*][p]Clan Market: This building is a clan exclusive shop with offers shared between you and the clan members.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Upgrading Clan Buildings requires clan member donations.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/10f76fa9673338e05b79e4341cc402c8738470ab.png"][/img][/h2][p][/p][/*][*][p]All clan members are able to contribute resources towards their respective clan cities.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaders and co-leaders are able to mark buildings as a priority to direct members.[/p][/*][*][p]Personalization options include clan banners, flags, and customizable elements[/p][/*][/list][h2][b][i]New Weapon: Trident de Montserrat[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/6911cf6f2da0fd0015035ea8e5ecce0acee9b36e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The Trident de Montserrat is a unique thrust offhand weapon, based on the historical trident design with connections to Vincenzo I Gonzaga.[/p][list][*][p][b]Weapon Type:[/b] Unique Thrust off-hand Weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Epoch:[/b] 5.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Unique Perk: Cold Blood[/p][list][*][p]Cold Blood: After a successful parry, the enemy's attack speed is reduced by 80% and resistance by 30% for 5 seconds. 5 seconds cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/87b90f9f1af2b4f2d565a9c2a08cd3041198205d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Item Donations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The ability to perform item donations to your Clan can now be researched via clan research.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]We have changed the icon for “Riposte”.[/p][list][*][p]Old Icon:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/c4d056ec6e54f03eda95fe8eae182d709cdfb9f7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New Icon:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/cf820b179db5a409583a3d3bbbac030968165772.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have Changed how the Calibration Perk operates.[/p][list][*][p]Old: [i]"A successful hit has a chance to increase precision for 2.5 seconds. 3s Cooldown."[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New: “A successful hit has a guaranteed chance to increase precision for the next attack.”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have added a confirmation popup before kicking a clan member.[/p][/*][*][p]We have decreased the number of Clan members capacity by 2. This should not affect clans with higher capacity and the capacity can be increased via research.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Shop Clan Rewards Preview[/h3][list][*][p]We have improved the display for items given to your clan when purchasing a clan offer within the shop.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/90932541a7507ac80d6c322d8d72dd98f8ebd744.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Profile Page Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We have added a Fandom Button, linking to our Wiki within the Player Profile Screen.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]The Parried Perk is now triggered only against melee weapons and not against ranged weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased the duration of the Concussion Perk from 2.5 to 3.5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased the difficulty of the final 4 clan bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]We have adjusted clan resource requests to fit the new clan city design and to be more varied.[/p][list][*][p]Increased yields and rewards for epoch 3+[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the quest to fulfill requests from 3 to 2 per day.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have heavily adjusted the Clan Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]We have lowered Siege Defense Coin Rewards from 200/400/600/800 to 200/300/400/500.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added El Cid to T3 Daily Legendary Battles.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added El Cid, Genghis and Saladin to T4 Daily Legendary Battles.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added El Cid, Genghis and Saladin to T5 Daily Legendary Battles.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixing[/h1][list][*][p]We have fixed an error where merging Tacticards can lead to connection errors.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing players to be stuck in a loading screen, when in a clan chat with members who have profile icons only available in a higher version.[/p][/*][*][p]We have improved the resolution of several icons and visuals from the game. This was particularly noticeable on Tablets.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added the Mace, Coat of Plates and Smith Garment to loot.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue allowing Crossbows, Arbalests and Chu-Ko-Nu to be affected by Bow buffs, they no longer are.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing Tacticard auto select to only select 2 Tacticards in maps where 3 were available.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue preventing the Fog Tacticard Synergy from taking effect when paired with Blinding Sun.[/p][/*][*][p]We have corrected an error with the Hoko Yari, previously it had gained an unintended stat boost when it hit 5.0. This has been corrected for all past and current instances of the item.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing some Tacticards to show no Synergy Effect. If conditions were met, the effect was still applied.[/p][/*][*][p]We have corrected the number of Selectable Tacticards, within event and raid battles.[/p][/*][*][p]We have corrected an issue causing the Tacticard Upgrade button to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added a minimum Character Limit to player names.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Summer Solstice Festival 2025
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/078b1650c039422a0a46724c53522baa76be93d3.png"][/img][b]The Summer Solstice Festival Has Begun! Vibrant stalls line the streets adorned with wreaths and the gifts of nature. Barren times fell upon the Kingdom in the winters of last year, and the people now yearn for colour and life. Traders from far and wide have come to see the adornments, and partake in their own ventures. Recent peace has even granted the citizens of further realms entry to the Kingdom for the occasion. As people meet and mingle, discussing their ways of life and the bright seasons ahead, all feel a sense of peace as they take a rest from their hardships. Please enjoy the Festivities.[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Time: This event runs until July 4th.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Overview[/h1][list][*][p]Quests, Collectibles and Campaign will run until: 1PM CEST, July 4th. [/p][/*][*][p]Shop will run until : 1PM CEST, July 5th. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][i]Mechanics[/i][/h2][list][*][p]Summer Wreaths have been added to the game for the duration of the event.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/7c39a8ee9cc95c945264a7e780369469a7e04f3c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summer Wreaths can be gained in the 4 following ways:[/p][list][*][p]Tapping on Maypole Collectibles that appear within the city.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing Event Quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Purchasing within the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]As a reward in campaign battles.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Summer Wreaths can then be spent in the event shop for various items.[/p][/*][*][p]Summer Wreaths that have not been spent upon conclusion of the event, are kept in the player’s profile and may be reused when the Summer Solstice Event returns the next year.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Event Collectibles[/h3][list][*][p]Maypoles spawn in the city and can be collected by tapping on them, granting a Wreath.[/p][list][*][p]A new Maypole spawns every 200 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]The first collectible with spawn with start of the event.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The maximum number of Event Collectibles within the city at any given time is 6.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b][i]Event Quests[/i][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Daily Quests[/h3][list][*][p]Each day 3 daily quests will repeat they are:[/p][list][*][p]Win 3 battles: 3 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Craft 3 pieces of equipment: 3 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect 3 Maypoles within the city: 3 Summer Wreaths.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/a6c36a3ad34f1924e318a48841b9737605d7d756.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]One Time Quests[/h3][list][*][p]There are several quests which can be completed only once throughout the event they are:[/p][list][*][p]Purchase 50 items from the shop: 5 Summer Wreaths, 1 Ruby.[/p][/*][*][p]Craft 6 Epics: 10 Summer Wreaths, 1 Ruby.[/p][/*][*][p]Finish 30 Daily Quests: 6 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Finish 50 Daily Quests: 8 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Finish 80 Daily Quests: 10 Summer Wreaths, Strawberry Icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fight 50 Battles: 5 Summer Wreaths, 1 Raid Ticket.[/p][/*][*][p]Get 2000 Coins: 5 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Get 5000 Coins, 10 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Reforge 1 Item: 8 Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Scrap 50 Items: 4 Summer Wreaths, 3 Pearls.[/p][/*][*][p]Spend 500 Gems: 10 Summer Wreaths, 2 Rubies.[/p][/*][*][p]Spend 5000 Gems: 10 Summer Wreaths, 10 Rubies.[/p][/*][*][p]Train Villagers 10 Times: 3 Summer Wreaths, 2 Pearls.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Event Achievement[/h3][list][*][p]Goal: Collect 222 Summer Wreaths from any source.[/p][list][*][p]Reward: Summer Wreath avatar frame.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Event Campaign[/h3][list][*][p]The campaign is available beginning in the Viking Age.[/p][/*][*][p]The event campaign has 6 different types of nodes they are:[/p][list][*][p]Regular battles: these battles cost Provisions and can be repeated.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss battles: these battles work similar to siege defense in a single player format.[/p][/*][*][p]Gates: the player must pay resources to continue which grants a reward.[/p][/*][*][p]Generator: generates Wreaths on a set interval.[/p][/*][*][p]Trader: requests items and grants rewards on a set interval.[/p][/*][*][p]Provisions collection points: There are two types:[/p][list][*][p]One time collection: Players can collect a set number of provisions at this node, then this node become inactive.[/p][/*][*][p]Repeatable collection: After unlocking the node, players can start the collection process, refilling on a 20 hour interval.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/db4cd8b42b2d780b5262506828e8d00f7343497d.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Event Economy[/h3][list][*][p]From collectibles:[/p][list][*][p]The average Wreaths per day from collectibles is 7.2.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]From quests:[/p][list][*][p]There are 9 Wreaths per day available from quests.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Total EC from event campaign:[/p][list][*][p]34 Summer Wreaths are available in Normal Event Missions.[/p][/*][*][p]30 Summer Wreaths are available in Event Boss Nodes.[/p][/*][*][p]Roughly 64 Summer Wreaths are available from Generator Nodes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]An additional 3 Summer Wreaths are available free within the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]The total number of Summer Wreaths available within the event is roughly 250.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Icons[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/241d7d3bc7ba8c74a54589c580a99251209bc2db.png"][/img]Frames[/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/ffbbad0c7b6b9bf2d0d7a3c1c28180ac0e3f09dc.png"][/img]Titles[/h2][list][*][p]Celebrant - Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Dancer - Summer Wreaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Green Knight - Green Knight’s Pack.[/p][/*][*][p]Sun-Kissed - Epic Sun-Kissed Pack.[/p][/*][*][p]Minstrel - Legendary Minstrel’s Pack.[/p][/*][*][p]Druid - Legendary Druid’s Offer.[/p][/*][*][p]Golden - Legendary Golden Offer.[/p][/*][*][p]Sun Knight - Final Campaign Boss (NEW)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dawn of Ages 2.0.5
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/340a3aa30027ddfcdf960c2b1c4f27a8125ffd16.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]As the heat builds upon the lands and crops have all been sewn, the people have taken a rest, to make improvements upon their homes and villages. The surplus of materials has allowed many a new quality of life never before seen within the realm, with several improvements taking hold across the continent,[/b][/h2][p][/p][h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]We now only show the “LR” markers on item cards if the item is either off-hand or two-handed.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added the “LR” markers on Drafts and Rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]We have extended the Item Preview Screen to the following places:[/p][list][*][p]The Ads Vendor Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Battle Pass Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Clan Boss Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Daily Mission Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Hardcore Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ladder Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Map Mission Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Map Request Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mission Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Raid Screens.[/p][/*][*][p]The Weekly Legendary Battles Details Screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Daily Legendary Battles Details Screen.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have added a filter for blueprints in the Item Selection Screen.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Grand Raid now has 4 Rubies guaranteed from completion.[/p][list][*][p]1 Ruby from each Progression Boss.[/p][list][*][p]2 Rubies for the Final Boss.[/p][/*][*][p]We have reduced the maximum quantity of Rubies in the Final Grand Raid Chest from 10 to 8 Rubies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The potential range of Rubies within Grand Raid is now 4-12.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bug Fixing,[/b][/h1][list][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing some chest shop offers to show too many examples on the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]The Loading Screen opening sound was not affected by sound settings, We have removed the sound from the game for the time being.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue where the Commander items category was missing in Storage.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue in Raid allowing troops to be healed in the Barracks.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing Off-hand weapons to not be shown in the Battle log.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue where the Thrown Stat was not shown on the Item Preview of the Javelin.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue where the stats on the Javelin preview were not notes.title: Dawn of Ages 2.0.4
notes.notes: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/340a3aa30027ddfcdf960c2b1c4f27a8125ffd16.png"][/img][/h2][h3][b]The inventions of new have inspired the people to begin examining their own tools of trade, making improvements upon them to better serve their purposes and need. Upon this era innovation has struck the realm, with new devices, concepts, and methods arising in all reaches. Many weapons of old have now been improved upon and spread throughout, with new weapons and combat strategy following quickly behind. Updates to the Royal Armory follow:[/b][/h3][p][/p][h1][b]Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Offhand Weapons[/b][/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/2698c9f12897aa2dc674cab4a044c4e6cc565187.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Offhand Weapon: Stiletto[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f0491ab78154faf1f1efaba2530a577f102353b5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The Stiletto has a low chance to Parry while held.[/p][list][*][p]X% chance to negate melee damage.[/p][list][*][p]Parry grants increased armor piercing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Guaranteed Perk “Life Ender”: The wielder deals extra damage when the enemy is below 50% health.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Offhand Weapon: Javelin[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/92bc0c83daeae8e69806dcffb370895e5dc0d177.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p]The Javelin is a ranged weapon thrown at the beginning of the battle.[/p][list][*][p]New ranged stats have been added to accommodate this and future items.[/p][list][*][p]Projectiles: 2[/p][list][*][p]After throwing both Javelins, the unit will switch to their main attack weapon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Range of the Javelin increases via epoch quality, from 12 units at Epoch 1, to 16 units at Epoch 5.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Guaranteed Perk “Punishing Hit”: Enemies hit by the javelin have 20% less armor and movement speed for 8s.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Item Preview Screen[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We have added a preview screen which allows players to click on each Item (Military and Economy Equipment) to view them.[/p][/*][*][p]Available Screens:[/p][list][*][p]Shop (Items and Drafts).[/p][list][*][p]Storage (Drafts).[/p][/*][*][p]Epoch (Items, with level and rarity)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Improved Repositioning in the formation screen for a smoother experience.[/p][list][*][p]Dragging over the edges of the virtual yard on the battlefield will always use the closest valid position.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have corrected “Practical Armor”, It is now unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]The Splash Screen upon opening the game has been returned to the standard notes.title: Step-by-Step Tutorial for Crossplay in Dawn of Ages
notes.notes:
We have released a video tutorial that provides a step-by-step guide on how to link your Dawn of Ages account between devices. This short tutorial is designed to help you connect your accounts for crossplay, ensuring that you can seamlessly share your game progress across platforms.

By linking your account, you can continue your playthrough on either your PC or mobile device at your convenience.

For detailed instructions, please watch the tutorial video below:
